name: Falrin's Vendetta
label: Quest
description: Falrin's Vendetta: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yes, it is true that I am familiar with this enchantment you require, adventurer. Yet I'm not one to give out favors freely, even if you were sent here by an old friend.
I hold nothing but hatred and contempt for our brutish ogre neighbors. And not only them, I hate the followers of Omokk just as much as I hate those that follow King Gordok.
I want you to kill them. Kill lots of them! Bring me the beads they carry around their neck as proof of your work. Do this and we shall talk about your request.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you performed the favor I asked of you, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmmm... Strangely enough I don't feel any better about my brother's death at the hands of those brutes.
Well, you held your end of the bargain. Let's see what I can do for you.
